instruction: Please turn on 'Enhanced Safe Browsing' in Chrome for better protection against dangerous websites.

metadata.explanation: Task requires agent to enable Enhanced Safe Browsing in Chrome settings. The getter reads Chrome Preferences to verify safebrowsing.enhanced is true.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads Chrome Preferences file and extracts safebrowsing.enhanced setting
Metric comparison (exact_match) appropriately performs strict string comparison for boolean setting verification
Expected value 'true' semantically correct for enabled Enhanced Safe Browsing state
Postconfig correctly kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to Preferences file
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the single requirement (Enhanced Safe Browsing enabled)
Edge cases handled: getter has try-except for file errors and missing keys, returns 'false' on error
Data flow is correct: getter extracts right state -> metric compares right aspect -> expected value matches requirement
